program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (cell<? a b)
      (or (< (first a) (first b))
          (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
    (define (shape-key cells) (format "~a" (sort (normalize-cells cells) cell<?)))
    (define (rot90 cells)
      (let ((h (+ 1 (apply max (map first cells)))))
        (normalize-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (second p) (- h 1 (first p)))) cells))))
    (define (rotate cells k)
      (let loop ([i 0] [cur (normalize-cells cells)])
        (if (= i (modulo k 4)) cur (loop (+ i 1) (rot90 cur)))))
    (define (reflect-v cells)
      (let* ((norm (normalize-cells cells))
             (w (+ 1 (apply max (map second norm)))))
        (normalize-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (- w 1 (second p)))) norm))))
    (define (variants cells)
      (remove-duplicates
       (append* (map (lambda (k)
                       (let ((rot (rotate cells k)))
                         (list (normalize-cells rot) (rotate (reflect-v cells) k))))
                     (list 0 1 2 3)))))
    (define (canonical cells)
      (first (sort (variants cells) (lambda (a b) (string<? (shape-key a) (shape-key b))))))
    (define comps (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 2)) (objects g 0)))
    (define counts (make-hash))
    (for ([obj (in-list comps)])
      (hash-update! counts (shape-key (canonical (obj-cells obj))) add1 0))
    (define odd (first (filter (lambda (o) (= (hash-ref counts (shape-key (canonical (obj-cells o)))) 1)) comps)))
    (let* ((cells (canonical (obj-cells odd)))
           (h (+ 1 (apply max (map first cells))))
           (w (+ 1 (apply max (map second cells)))))
      (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c) (if (member? (list r c) cells) 8 0))))))
